title: Tiếng Anh: Đọc hiểu main idea
subject: Tiếng Anh

questions.prompt: Read the sentence: "Many students use short daily quizzes to identify weak areas before taking a full mock exam." What is the main idea?

options.text: Daily quizzes help students find weaknesses.

questions.explanation: The sentence focuses on using short quizzes to identify weak areas.

questions.prompt: Which option is closest in meaning to "identify" in the sentence above?
questions.explanation: "Identify" means to recognize or find out what something is.

questions.prompt: Short practice sets are useful because they are focused and easy to repeat. What can be inferred?

options.text: Students can review a specific skill many times.
Students only need one full exam.
Focused practice takes more than a day.

questions.explanation: If a practice set is focused and easy to repeat, students can revisit the same skill multiple times.
